---
name: Crash or stutter report
about: The game closed by itself, froze, or drops frames
labels: bug
---

**What happened**
<!-- e.g. the game closed while loading Central Yharnam; stutter on every map change -->

**Attach**
- [ ] `crash_<time>.txt` from `<saves folder>\logs\` (if it crashed)
- [ ] `perf_events.log` and the newest `run_<time>_stalls.log` (if it stutters)
- [ ] The diag report from `tools\Collect_Crash_History.bat` if the crash happened before the logs existed

Do not attach game files. The logs contain your Windows version, graphics card, driver and game settings, but
not your online account name or password.

**System**
- Graphics card and driver version:
- RAM / page file size (if known):
- Windows version:
- bbport-plus version (Advanced page, bottom):
- Upscaler / preset / output resolution:
